summary: Explains Instanced Static Mesh (ISM) and Hierarchical ISM components for drawing many copies of one mesh cheaply, ISM vs HISM trade-offs (including with Nanite), per-instance custom data, and the tools that create them: Blueprint components, Merge Actors Batch, Foliage Mode, Packed Level Actor, and Modeling Mode Harvest Instances/Pattern/ISM Editor.

Reference for Material Editor nodes that output vectors: world/camera/object/particle positions, camera and reflection vectors, constant 2/3/4 vectors (with 2/3/4+click shortcuts), LightVector for decals/light functions, Object Bounds/Orientation, pixel and vertex normals, pre-skinned local normal/position, and the Vector Noise node (Cellnoise, Perlin, Gradient, Curl, Voronoi) with derivative helpers.
